newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Deng the greatest reformer - Taiwan opposition head.
newsitem.headline: Deng the greatest reformer - Taiwan opposition head.

text.p: The head of Taiwan's Democratic Progressive Party, which advocates the island's independence from China, hailed Beijing's late paramount leader Deng Xiaoping as the greatest reformer, a newspaper reported on Saturday.
"Deng Xiaoping was the greatest reformer in Chinese history," the mass circulation United Daily News newspaper quoted party chairman Hsu Hsin-liang as saying.
Deng opened up the totalitarian communist China to world economies and "his wisdom and courage deserve admiration", said the chairman of the island's biggest opposition party.
"We cannot ignore Deng's role as a reformer in Chinese history," he said.
China, which has regarded Taiwan as a renegade province since the end of a civil war in 1949, threatens to recover the island by force if it declares independence.
Both governments in Taiwan and China say they want reunification, but under very different terms.
